description: This file defines the GrainManifest class, which encapsulates information about available grains and their interfaces within the Orleans framework. It includes properties for the grains and interfaces, and a constructor to initialize these properties.

classes.name: GrainManifest
classes.description: A sealed class that holds information about grain types and interface properties in Orleans.

methods.name: GrainManifest
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the GrainManifest with dictionaries of grains and interfaces.
